title: Pack scored RAG candidates into a fixed token budget
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He binds a FixtureRagRetriever corpus and loads the `context_pack` Agentic Recipe for: Pack scored RAG candidates into a fixed token budget. He runs `run_recipe` context_pack (retrieve → pack via `assemble_context_within_budget`) and verifies selected_ids / within_budget. [^jev-us05]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `context_pack` (`ContextPackTemplate`): `rag_retrieve` → `rag_pack`. Host binds `RagRetriever` (story: `FixtureRagRetriever` via `environment.rag_corpus`). Pack calls `assemble_context_within_budget`. Product verb `run_recipe`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `budget_pack.yaml`: environment.rag_corpus + graph.recipe context_pack + run_recipe; hard expects on selected_ids / within_budget.
